**Rationale:** The claim directly contradicts the study population. SELECT enrolled only adults WITH established cardiovascular disease; the claim extends the "cardiovascular protection" to adults WITHOUT established cardiovascular disease. This is classic extrapolation beyond the evidence base. While SELECT demonstrated a real cardiovascular benefit in secondary prevention (HR 0.80), applying this to primary prevention in overweight adults without prior CVD events is unsupported. The evidence does not address whether semaglutide provides similar protection in primary prevention, making this an overclaim.
